pattern: ^SELECT .+ FROM ([a-zA-Z0-9]+) WHERE Name = '(.*?)' AND DestAirport = \(SELECT AirportCode FROM airports WHERE City = '(.*?)'\)$
correction: Join the required tables directly and filter based on the relationship between them.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that use separate subqueries for airline and airport instead of joining the appropriate tables directly, leading to an incomplete or incorrect result set.
